entities.summary: Weyler, a notable figure in the history of Cuba, associated with Wars of Independence and the End of Spanish Rule (1892–1898). Preceded by Cuban Revolution and General Weyler's reconcentration camps cause mass civilian deaths. Their legacy influenced Cuban Republic inaugurated — May 20, 1902 and José Martí killed at Battle of Dos Ríos — May 19, 1895.
